digest.component_or_area: MCP server config ownership and credential seam enforcement
propositions: Below-seam ambient config and credential reads in mcp_server.py and _mcp_auth.py must be routed through owned composition-root resolvers in config.py to satisfy seam approval gates.
Three new owned resolvers (mcp_gate, compose_config, read_secret_env) must be added to config.py to replace direct ambient reads while preserving per-request resolution semantics.
All corresponding entries for MCP files must be removed from scripts/config_ownership_exceptions.LEGACY_EXCEPTIONS, and scripts/check_config_ownership.py must report zero findings.
Subsystem behavioral test suites (MCP facades, auth, plan-review, writes) must remain green and unmodified post-cutover with no behavioral delta.
